# Division: dst[i] = a[i] / b[i] uses Div (float types only).

# The scalar program is the reference behavior.
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want
cmp ops.go ops.go.guarded

# The simd build must behave identically.
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func DivFloat32s(dst, a, b []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] / b[i]
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import "simd"

func DivFloat32s(dst, a, b []float32) {
	for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
		_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(a[_i:])
		_v2, _ := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(b[_i:])
		_v1.Div(_v2).StorePart(dst[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
}
-- testmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/test"
)

func main() {
	dst := make([]float32, 4)
	a := []float32{10, 20, 9, 4}
	b := []float32{2, 4, 3, 2}
	test.DivFloat32s(dst, a, b)
	fmt.Println(dst[0], dst[1], dst[2], dst[3])
}
-- testmain/output --
5 5 3 2
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 1 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
-- ops.go.guarded --
//go:build !goexperiment.simd

package test

func DivFloat32s(dst, a, b []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] / b[i]
	}
}
